content:
We're very excited to announce FORM, a new research centre at the University of Southern Denmark that will focus on the formalisation of new and existing Computer Science in Lean (http://sdu.dk/form).

FORM is an ambitious, long-term investment. As part of its opening, we're looking for postdocs, (tenure-track) assistant professors, and (tenured) associate professors interested in formal methods, Lean, CSLib, and related topics. To apply, you can find the calls here:

:point_right: Postdoc Positions in Formal Methods and Programming Languages

:point_right: Assistant Professor (tenure-track) and Associate Professor (tenured) Positions in Formal Methods

Deadline for applications: 11 January 2026.

Feel free to reach out to me if these calls interest you. Sharing this news in your networks is very appreciated.
